document.name: 1.5 Ton Window Air Conditioner
document.description: 1.5-ton window air conditioner with rotary compressor and 18000 BTU capacity. Features turbo cooling, multiple flow speeds, quiet air supply, washable filter, 360° 3D air delivery, and auto restart. Unit color: white. AC 220–240 V, 50 Hz. Net dimensions: 960 × 430 × 732 mm. The image states a 3-year compressor warranty and a 1-year product warranty.
